objective: Bind each Session to a closed, default-empty set of Connections-estate connectors declared at create, and enforce that set at daemon admission on the connector invoke path independently of any catalog or client filter (ADR 0052 Decision 3).
falsifiable_claim: A connector invocation made on behalf of a Session whose authority_profile does not name that connector refuses with typed 403 session_authority_out_of_profile and a durable refusal receipt before org policy, principal scope and the wallet crossing; the same invocation under a Session that names the connector reaches the ordinary authority challenge; naming an unknown connector refuses the create; deleting a connector fences every Session that named it; the profile and the refusal survive a daemon kill and restart.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: check:session-authority-profile drives the DIRECT daemon path (no UI): empty-profile refusal with a durable receipt, in-profile authority challenge, session-less invoke unchanged, anonymous session-scoped invoke 401 before the record load, bogus session 404, unknown connection 412, malformed profile 422, deletion fencing, and identical refusals after a SIGKILL restart; the verifier is CI-gated and floor-pinned at 21 assertions so a deleted assertion is red.
remaining_nonclaims: The generic-cli-local harness makes no connector calls, so on the alpha profile the binding is proven at the daemon path; a harness that calls connectors must carry session_ref (a session-less invoke is the operator's own direct act).
No standing-envelope draw-down, budget or expiry is bound at attach (M13.3); the profile names connectors, not lease facets.
No claim that in-profile invocations complete: the positive path is proven to the wallet authority challenge; completion needs the deployment authority node (see check:alpha-journey).
source_provenance: Landed 2026-09-07 by the bounded-alpha program (commit 3bec178d1); recorded in canon-to-code-delta.md § Journey verification XV.
